2026-09-28 17:11:33.713388 | controller |
2026-09-28 17:11:33.713393 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-28 17:11:33.713408 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-28 17:11:33.713419 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-28 17:11:33.713424 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-28 17:11:33.713434 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-28 17:11:33.713445 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-28 17:11:33.713449 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
